label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E2 is survey-team-observed indirect evidence of potentially productive land left unused, making it a target under the national criteria; technical survey is unavailable. E1 is weaker second-hand indirect evidence and does not independently establish contamination. The evidence supports a cautious recommendation, not a final determination.
flags: E2 concerns a field in only part of the area; confirm the appropriate extent for action at sign-off.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: A teacher said people stopped using the land at the edge of the pasture after an armed group camped there around 2006, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: The report of an armed-group camp and subsequent non-use suggests possible contamination, but does not confirm EO; the teacher is not reported as having witnessed EO or the relevant events, so this is treated as second-hand.

E2.quote: The survey team saw that a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed.
E2.note: The team's observation of potentially productive land left unused suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO; the source is the survey team's own observation.
